Changes made for this game:
"Run Amok": retained original 0.800–104.850 seconds, trimming leading silence and the near-silent tail; added a 5 ms opening fade and 150 ms ending fade; re-encoded to stereo MP3 at 192 kb/s.
"Fluffing a Duck": selected the first rendition, original 0.000–31.460 seconds, omitting the second rendition; added a 10 ms opening fade and 510 ms ending fade to the first rendition's decay; re-encoded to stereo MP3 at 192 kb/s.
No pitch or tempo changes. Music is repeated in the game. No endorsement by the composer is implied.
